+"""Best Book Awards: record and query award nominations.
+
+This module provides the server-side support for the "Best Book Awards"
+feature.  The :class:`Bestbook` class exposes the database-backed
+operations (add / remove / get_count / get_awards / get_leaderboard)
+and the :class:`AwardConditionsError` exception type.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+
+from infogami.plugins import db
+from openlibrary.core.bookshelves import Bookshelves
+from openlibrary.core.helpers import get_ol_host
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# Preset bookshelf id for "Already Read" (see Bookshelves.PRESET_BOOKSHELVES).
+ALREADY_READ_SHELF_ID = 3
+
+
+class Bestbook(db.CommonExtras):
+    """Database-backed operations for Best Book Awards."""
+
+    TABLE = "bestbooks"
+
+    class AwardConditionsError(Exception):
+        """Raised when the preconditions for an award are not met."""

```
def prepare_multipart(fields):
    """Construct a multipart/form-data payload from a mapping of fields."""
    if not isinstance(fields, Mapping):
        raise TypeError('fields must be a mapping')

    for name, value in fields.items():
        if isinstance(value, str):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
            if 'filename' not in value and 'content' not in value:
                raise ValueError('field %r must provide filename or content' % name)
            continue
        raise TypeError('field %r must be a string or a mapping' % name)

    msg = MIMEMultipart('form-data')
    boundary = msg.get_boundary()

    for name in sorted(fields):
        value = fields[name]
        if isinstance(value, str):
            part = Message(policy=email.policy.HTTP)
            part['Content-Type'] = 'text/plain'
            part['Content-Disposition'] = 'form-data; name="%s"' % name
            part.set_payload(value.encode('utf-8'))
            msg.attach(part)
        else:
            filename = value.get('filename')
            content = value.get('content')
            mime_type = value.get('mime_type')
            if content is not None:
                part = Message(policy=email.policy.HTTP)
                if mime_type is None:
                    mime_type = 'octet-stream'
                part['Content-Type'] = 'application/%s' % mime_type
                disp = 'form-data; name="%s"' % name
                if filename:
                    disp += '; filename="%s"' % os.path.basename(filename)
                part['Content-Disposition'] = disp
                part.set_payload(to_bytes(content))
                msg.attach(part)
            else:
                with open(filename, 'rb') as f:
                    data = f.read()
                if mime_type is None:
                    try:
                        guessed = mimetypes.guess_type(filename)
                    except Exception:
                        guessed = None
                    mime_type = guessed or 'octet-stream'
                part = Message(policy=email.policy.HTTP)
                part['Content-Transfer-Encoding'] = 'base64'
                part['Content-Type'] = 'application/%s' % mime_type
                disp = 'form-data; name="%s"' % name
                disp += '; filename="%s"' % os.path.basename(filename)
                part['Content-Disposition'] = disp
                b64 = base64.b64encode(data).decode('ascii')
                wrapped = '\n'.join([b64[i:i+76] for i in range(0, len(b64), 76)]
                part.set_payload(wrapped)
                msg.attach(part)

    gen = email.generator.Generator(policy=email.policy.HTTP)
    body = gen.flatten(msg).encode('utf-8')
    content_type = 'multipart/form-data; boundary=%s' % boundary
    return content_type, body
```

export class VoiceBroadcastPlayback
    extends TypedEventEmitter<VoiceBroadcastPlaybackEvent, EventMap>
    implements IDestroyable {
    private state = VoiceBroadcastPlaybackState.Stopped;
    private infoState: VoiceBroadcastInfoState;
    private chunkEvents = new VoiceBroadcastChunkEvents();
    private playbacks = new Map<string, Playback>();
    private currentlyPlaying: MatrixEvent;
    private lastInfoEvent: MatrixEvent;
    private chunkRelationHelper: RelationsHelper;
    private infoRelationHelper: RelationsHelper;
    private positionMs = 0;
    private durationMs = 0;
    private liveData = new SimpleObservable<number[]>();

    public constructor(
        public readonly infoEvent: MatrixEvent,
        private client: MatrixClient,
    ) {
        super();
        this.addInfoEvent(this.infoEvent);
        this.setUpRelationsHelper();
    }

    private setUpRelationsHelper(): void {
        this.infoRelationHelper = new RelationsHelper(
            this.infoEvent,
            RelationType.Reference,
            VoiceBroadcastInfoEventType,
            this.client,
        );
        this.infoRelationHelper.on(RelationsHelperEvent.Add, this.addInfoEvent);
        this.infoRelationHelper.emitCurrent();

        this.chunkRelationHelper = new RelationsHelper(
            this.infoEvent,
            RelationType.Reference,
            EventType.RoomMessage,
            this.client,
        );
        this.chunkRelationHelper.on(RelationsHelperEvent.Add, this.addChunkEvent);
        this.chunkRelationHelper.emitCurrent();
    }

    private addChunkEvent = async (event: MatrixEvent): Promise<boolean> => {
        const eventId = event.getId();

        if (!eventId
            || eventId.startsWith("~!") // don't add local events
            || event.getContent()?.msgtype !== MsgType.Audio // don't add non-audio event
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        this.chunkEvents.addEvent(event);
        this.emit(VoiceBroadcastPlaybackEvent.LengthChanged, this.chunkEvents.getLength());

        if (this.getState() !== VoiceBroadcastPlaybackState.Stopped) {
            await this.enqueueChunk(event);
        }

        if (this.getState() === VoiceBroadcastPlaybackState.Buffering) {
            await this.start();
        }

        return true;
    };

    private addInfoEvent = (event: MatrixEvent): void => {
        if (this.lastInfoEvent && this.lastInfoEvent.getTs() >= event.getTs()) {
            // Only handle newer events
            return;
        }

        const state = event.getContent()?.state;

        if (!Object.values(VoiceBroadcastInfoState).includes(state)) {
            // Do not handle unknown voice broadcast states
            return;
        }

        this.lastInfoEvent = event;
        this.setInfoState(state);
    };

    private async loadChunks(): Promise<void> {
        const relations = getReferenceRelationsForEvent(this.infoEvent, EventType.RoomMessage, this.client);
        const chunkEvents = relations?.getRelations();

        if (!chunkEvents) {
            return;
        }

        this.chunkEvents.addEvents(chunkEvents);

        for (const chunkEvent of chunkEvents) {
            await this.enqueueChunk(chunkEvent);
        }
    }

    private async enqueueChunk(chunkEvent: MatrixEvent) {
        const sequenceNumber = parseInt(chunkEvent.getContent()?.[VoiceBroadcastChunkEventType]?.sequence, 10);
        if (isNaN(sequenceNumber) || sequenceNumber < 1) return;

        const helper = new MediaEventHelper(chunkEvent);
        const blob = await helper.sourceBlob.value;
        const buffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
        const playback = PlaybackManager.instance.createPlaybackInstance(buffer);
        await playback.prepare();
        playback.clockInfo.populatePlaceholdersFrom(chunkEvent);
        this.playbacks.set(chunkEvent.getId(), playback);
        playback.on(UPDATE_EVENT, (state) => this.onPlaybackStateChange(playback, state));
        playback.clockInfo.liveData.onUpdate((position) => this.onChunkClockUpdate(chunkEvent, position));
    }

    private onChunkClockUpdate(chunkEvent: MatrixEvent, position: number): void {
        if (this.currentlyPlaying?.getId() !== chunkEvent.getId()) {
            return;
        }

        const newPosition = this.chunkEvents.getLengthTo(chunkEvent) + position;
        if (newPosition === this.positionMs) {
            return;
        }
        this.positionMs = newPosition;
        this.liveData.update([this.timeSeconds, this.durationSeconds]);
        this.emit(VoiceBroadcastPlaybackEvent.PositionChanged, this.positionMs);
    }

    private async onPlaybackStateChange(playback: Playback, newState: PlaybackState) {
        if (newState !== PlaybackState.Stopped) {
            return;
        }

        await this.playNext();
    }

        if (!this.currentlyPlaying) return;

        const next = this.chunkEvents.getNext(this.currentlyPlaying);

        if (next) {
            this.setState(VoiceBroadcastPlaybackState.Playing);
            this.currentlyPlaying = next;
            await this.playbacks.get(next.getId())?.play();
            return;

        if (this.getInfoState() === VoiceBroadcastInfoState.Stopped) {
            this.setState(VoiceBroadcastPlaybackState.Stopped);
        } else {

            this.setState(VoiceBroadcastPlaybackState.Buffering);
        }
    }

            this.currentlyPlaying = toPlay;

        if (!targetPlayback) {
            return;
        }

        if (this.currentlyPlaying) {
            const currentPlayback = this.playbacks.get(this.currentlyPlaying.getId());
            await currentPlayback?.stop();

        this.currentlyPlaying = targetEvent;
        const offsetInChunk = targetMs - this.chunkEvents.getLengthTo(targetEvent);

        this.positionMs = targetMs;
        this.liveData.update([this.timeSeconds, this.durationSeconds]);

    }

        this.setState(VoiceBroadcastPlaybackState.Stopped);

        if (this.currentlyPlaying) {
            this.playbacks.get(this.currentlyPlaying.getId()).stop();

    }

        // stopped voice broadcasts cannot be paused
        if (this.getState() === VoiceBroadcastPlaybackState.Stopped) return;

        if (!this.currentlyPlaying) return;
        this.playbacks.get(this.currentlyPlaying.getId()).pause();
    }

        if (!this.currentlyPlaying) {
            // no playback to resume, start from the beginning
            this.start();
            return;
        }

        this.setState(VoiceBroadcastPlaybackState.Playing);

     * stopped → playing
     * playing → paused
     * paused → playing
     */
    public async toggle() {
        if (this.state === VoiceBroadcastPlaybackState.Stopped) {
            await this.start();
            return;
        }

            this.resume();
            return;
        }

        this.pause();
    }

    public getState(): VoiceBroadcastPlaybackState {
        return this.state;
    }

    private setState(state: VoiceBroadcastPlaybackState): void {
        if (this.state === state) {
            return;
        }

        this.state = state;
        this.emit(VoiceBroadcastPlaybackEvent.StateChanged, state, this);
    }

    public getInfoState(): VoiceBroadcastInfoState {
        return this.infoState;
    }

    private setInfoState(state: VoiceBroadcastInfoState): void {
        if (this.infoState === state) {
            return;
        }

        this.infoState = state;
        this.emit(VoiceBroadcastPlaybackEvent.InfoStateChanged, state);
    }

    public destroy(): void {
        this.chunkRelationHelper.destroy();
        this.infoRelationHelper.destroy();
        this.removeAllListeners();

        this.chunkEvents = new VoiceBroadcastChunkEvents();
        this.playbacks.forEach(p => p.destroy());
        this.playbacks = new Map<string, Playback>();
    }

    private events: MatrixEvent[] = [];

    public getEvents(): MatrixEvent[] {

    public addEvents(events: MatrixEvent[]): void {

        }, false);

        if (atLeastOneNew) {

        }

    public includes(event: MatrixEvent): boolean {

        if (index === -1) {
            return 0;

        return this.events.slice(0, index).reduce((length: number, e: MatrixEvent) => {
            return length + this.calculateChunkLength(e);
        }, 0);

     * @param time The playback time in milliseconds.

    public findByTime(time: number): MatrixEvent | null {
        let cumulative = 0;
        for (const event of this.events) {
            const chunkLength = this.calculateChunkLength(event);
            if (cumulative + chunkLength > time) {
                return event;
            }
            cumulative += chunkLength;
        }
        // If time equals or exceeds the total length, return the last event
        if (this.events.length > 0) {
            return this.events[this.events.length - 1];
        }

+Ericsson ECCLI
+***************
+
+The Ericsson ECCLI platform is supported by the ``eric_eccli`` connection plugin. This
+platform is accessed over the ``network_cli`` connection type, which uses a persistent
+connection to the remote device.
+
+Connection options
+==================
+
+The following options are available for the ``eric_eccli`` platform:
+
+- ``host``: the hostname or IP address of the remote device.
+- ``port``: the TCP port to connect to (defaults to 22).
+- ``remote_user``: the username for authentication.
+- ``password``: the password for authentication.
+- ``ssh_keyfile``: path to an SSH private key.
+- ``timeout``: the connection timeout in seconds.
+- ``become``: whether to elevate privileges after connecting.
+
+Example inventory
+=================
+
+.. code-block:: ini
+
+    [eric_eccli]
+    router1 ansible_host=192.0.2.10 ansible_user=admin ansible_password=secret
+
+    [eric_eccli:vars]
+    ansible_connection=network_cli
+    ansible_network_os=eric_eccli
+
+Using network_cli
+==================
+
+To run commands on an ECCLI device, use the ``eric_eccli_command`` module with the
+``network_cli`` connection:
+
+.. code-block:: yaml
+
+    - name: Run ECCLI commands
+    hosts: eric_eccli
+    gather_facts: false
+    tasks:
+      - name: Show version and interface status
+        eric_eccli_command:
+          commands:
+            - show version
+            - show interfaces
+          wait_for:
+            - "output contains 'Uptime'"
+          match: all
+          retries: 5
+          interval: 2
+
+The terminal plugin for this platform disables paging so that command output is returned
+in a single response, and it configures the shell prompt and error regexes used by the
+connection layer.
+
+See :ref:`network_cli` for details on the ``network_cli`` connection type and the
+:ref:`network_os` variable.

+.. _platform_eric_eccli:
+
+Ericsson ECCLI
+***************
+
+The Ericsson ECCLI platform is supported by the ``eric_eccli`` connection plugin. This
+platform is accessed over the ``network_cli`` connection type, which uses a persistent
+connection to the remote device.
+
+Connection options
+==================
+
+The following options are available for the ``eric_eccli`` platform:
+
+- ``host``: the hostname or IP address of the remote device.
+- ``port``: the TCP port to connect to (defaults to 22).
+- ``remote_user``: the username for authentication.
+- ``password``: the password for authentication.
+- ``ssh_keyfile``: path to an SSH private key.
+- ``timeout``: the connection timeout in seconds.
+- ``become``: whether to elevate privileges after connecting.
+
+Example inventory
+=================
+
+.. code-block:: ini
+
+    [eric_eccli]
+    router1 ansible_host=192.0.2.10 ansible_user=admin ansible_password=secret
+
+    [eric_eccli:vars]
+    ansible_connection=network_cli
+    ansible_network_os=eric_eccli
+
+Using network_cli
+==================
+
+To run commands on an ECCLI device, use the ``eric_eccli_command`` module with the
+``network_cli`` connection:
+
+.. code-block:: yaml
+
+    - name: Run ECCLI commands
+    hosts: eric_eccli
+    gather_facts: false
+    tasks:
+      - name: Show version and interface status
+        eric_eccli_command:
+          commands:
+            - show version
+            - show interfaces
+          wait_for:
+            - "output contains 'Uptime'"
+          match: all
+          retries: 5
+          interval: 2
+
+The terminal plugin for this platform disables paging so that command output is returned
+in a single response, and it configures the shell prompt and error regexes used by the
+connection layer.
+
+See :ref:`network_cli` for details on the ``network_cli`` connection type and the
+:ref:`network_os` variable.

+.. _platform_eric_eccli:
+
+Ericsson ECCLI
+***************
+
+The Ericsson ECCLI platform is supported by the ``eric_eccli`` connection plugin. This
+platform is accessed over the ``network_cli`` connection type, which uses a persistent
+connection to the remote device.
+
+Connection options
+==================
+
+The following options are available for the ``eric_eccli`` platform:
+
+- ``host``: the hostname or IP address of the remote device.
+- ``port``: the TCP port to connect to (defaults to 22).
+- ``remote_user``: the username for authentication.
+- ``password``: the password for authentication.
+- ``ssh_keyfile``: path to an SSH private key.
+- ``timeout``: the connection timeout in seconds.
+- ``become``: whether to elevate privileges after connecting.
+
+Example inventory
+=================
+
+.. code-block:: ini
+
+    [eric_eccli]
+    router1 ansible_host=192.0.2.10 ansible_user=admin ansible_password=secret
+
+    [eric_eccli:vars]
+    ansible_connection=network_cli
+    ansible_network_os=eric_eccli
+
+Using network_cli
+==================
+
+To run commands on an ECCLI device, use the ``eric_eccli_command`` module with the
+``network_cli`` connection:
+
+.. code-block:: yaml
+
+    - name: Run ECCLI commands
+    hosts: eric_eccli
+    gather_facts: false
+    tasks:
+      - name: Show version and interface status
+        eric_eccli_command:
+          commands:
+            - show version
+            - show interfaces
+          wait_for:
+            - "output contains 'Uptime'"
+          match: all
+          retries: 5
+          interval: 2
+
+The terminal plugin for this platform disables paging so that command output is returned
+in a single response, and it configures the shell prompt and error regexes used by the
+connection layer.
+
+See :ref:`network_cli` for details on the ``network_cli`` connection type and the
+:ref:`network_os` variable.

+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function, with_statement
+
+from ansible.plugins.cliconf import Cliconf
+
+try:
+    from collections.abc import Mapping
+except ImportError:
+    from collections import Mapping
+
+
+class EricEccli(Cliconf):
+    """Ericsson ECCLI cliconf plugin"""
+
+    device_info = None
+
+    def get_device_info(self, connection):
+        """Get device info from the device"""
+        if self.device_info is None:
+            output = connection.get("show version")
+            self.device_info = self.parse_device_info(output)
+        return self.device_info
+
+    def parse_device_info(self, output):
+        """Parse the output of 'show version' into a device info mapping"""
+        device_info = {}
+        lines = output.splitlines()
+        for line in lines:
+            line = line.strip()
+            if line.startswith("System description"):
+                device_info["system_description"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
+            elif line.startswith("System version"):
+                device_info["system_version"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
+            elif line.startswith("System serial number"):
+                device_info["serial_number"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
+            elif line.startswith("Uptime"):
+                device_info["uptime"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
+        return device_info
+
+    def get_config(self, connection):
+        """Get the running configuration from the device"""
+        return connection.get("show configuration")
+
+    def edit_config(self, connection, config):
+        """Edit the device configuration"""
+        commands = ["configure terminal"]
+        commands.extend(config)
+        commands.append("end")
+        return connection.edit_config(commands)
+
+    def get(self, connection, cmd):
+        """Run a single command and return its output"""
+        return connection.get(cmd)
+
+    def get_capabilities(self, connection):
+        """Return the capabilities of the device"""
+        return {
+            "network_api": "cliconf",
+            "device_info": self.get_device_info(connection),
+            "network_os": "eric_eccli",
+        }
+
+    def run_commands(self, command, check_rc=True):
+        """Run a command on the device and return its output"""
+        return connection.get(command)

+def get_connection(module):
+    """
+    Get the connection for the module.
+    """
+    connection = Connection(module)
+    if not connection:
+        module.fail_json(
+            msg="unable to open connection to %s" % module.params["host"]

+    elements: str
+  wait_for:
+    description:
+      - List of conditions to evaluate against the command output.
+    alias: waitfor
+    type: list
+    elements: str
+  match:
+    description:
+      - Whether all or any of the wait_for conditions must be satisfied.
+    default: all
+    choices:
+      - all
+      - any
+    type: str
+  retries:
+    description:
+      - Number of times to retry executing the commands before failing.
+    default: 10
+    type: int
+  interval:
+    description:
+      - Number of seconds to wait between retries.
+    default: 1
+    type: int
+"""
+
+EXAMPLES = """
+- name: Run a simple command
+  eric_eccli_command:
+    commands:
+      - show version
+
+- name: Run commands and wait for a condition
+  eric_eccli_command:
+    commands:
+      - show version
+    wait_for:
+      - "output contains 'version'"
+    match: any
+    retries: 5
+    interval: 2
+"""
+
+RETURN = """
+stdout:
+  description: List of command outputs, one entry per executed command.
+  type: list
+  returned: always
+  sample: ["Linux version 1.2.3"]
+warnings:
+  description: Warnings collected during execution, e.g. skipped config commands in check mode.
+  type: list
+  returned: when warnings are present
+  sample: ["only non-config commands are supported when using check mode, not executing configure terminal"]
+"""
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
+from ansible.module_utils.network.eric_eccli.eric_eccli import run_commands
+
+
+def parse_commands(module, warnings):
+    """Normalize the module's commands parameter into a list of command items.
+
+    In check mode, configuration commands (text starting with 'conf') are
+    removed from the returned list and a warning is appended for each.
+    """
+    commands = module.params['commands']
+    check_mode = module.check_mode
+
+    normalized = []
+    for cmd in commands:
+        if check_mode and cmd.startswith('conf'):
+            warnings.append(
+                'only non-config commands are supported when using check mode, not executing %s' % cmd
+            )
+        else:
+            normalized.append(cmd)
+    return normalized
+
+
+def main():
+    module = AnsibleModule(
+        argument_spec={
+            'commands': {'required': True, 'type': 'list', 'elements': 'str'},
+            'wait_for': {'required': False, 'type': 'list', 'elements': 'str', 'alias': 'waitfor'},
+            'match': {'required': False, 'type': 'str', 'choices': ['all', 'any'], 'default': 'all'},
+            'retries': {'required': False, 'type': 'int', 'default': 10},
+            'interval': {'required': False, 'type': 'int', 'default': 1},
+        },
+        supports_check_mode=True,
+    )
+
+    warnings = []
+    commands = parse_commands(module, warnings)
+
+    wait_for = module.params.get('wait_for') or []
+    match = module.params['match']
+    retries = module.params['retries']
+    interval = module.params['interval']
+
+    stdout = []
+    for attempt in range(1, retries + 1):
+        stdout = run_commands(module, commands)
+
+        if not wait_for:
+            break
+
+        conditions_met = []
+        for condition in wait_for:
+            # Simple condition evaluation: check if any command output contains the condition string
+            met = any(condition in output for output in stdout)
+            conditions_met.append(met)
+
+        if match == 'all':
+            if all(conditions_met):
+                break
+        else:  # match == 'any'
+            if any(conditions_met):
+                break
+
+        if attempt < retries:
+            import time
+            time.sleep(interval)
+
+    if wait_for and not (all(conditions_met) if match == 'all' else any(conditions_met)):
+        unmet = [c for c, m in zip(wait_for, conditions_met) if not m]
+        module.fail_json(
+            msg='wait_for conditions not satisfied: %s' % ', '.join(unmet),
+            stdout=stdout,
+            warnings=warnings,
+        )
+
+    module.exit_json(
+        changed=False,
+        stdout=stdout,
+        warnings=warnings,
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+class EricEccli(Cliconf):

+
+    device_info = None

+    def get_device_info(self, connection):
+        """Get device info from the device"""
+        if self.device_info is None:
+            output = connection.get("show version")
+            self.device_info = self.parse_device_info(output)
+        return self.device_info
+
+    def parse_device_info(self, output):
+        """Parse the output of 'show version' into a device info mapping"""
+        device_info = {}
+        lines = output.splitlines()
+        for line in lines:
+            line = line.strip()
+            if line.startswith("System description"):
+                device_info["system_description"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
+            elif line.startswith("System version"):
+                device_info["system_version"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
+            elif line.startswith("System serial number"):
+                device_info["serial_number"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
+            elif line.startswith("Uptime"):
+                device_info["uptime"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
+        return device_info
+
+    def get_config(self, connection):
+        """Get the running configuration from the device"""
+        return connection.get("show configuration")
+
+    def edit_config(self, connection, config):
+        """Edit the device configuration"""
+        commands = ["configure terminal"]
+        commands.extend(config)
+        commands.append("end")
+        return connection.edit_config(commands)
+
+    def get(self, connection, cmd):
+        """Run a single command and return its output"""
+        return connection.get(cmd)
+
+    def get_capabilities(self, connection):
+        """Return the capabilities of the device"""
+        return {

+            "network_os": "eric_eccli",

def load_data(
    rec: dict,
    account_key: str | None = None,
    existing_edition: "Edition | None" = None,
):
    """
    Adds a new Edition to Open Library, or overwrites existing_edition with rec data.

    The overwrite option exists for cases where the existing edition data
    should be (nearly) completely overwritten by rec data. Revision 1 promise
    items are an example.

    Checks for existing Works.
    Creates a new Work, and Author, if required,
    otherwise associates the new Edition with the existing Work.

    :param dict rec: Edition record to add (no further checks at this point)
    :rtype: dict
    :return:
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": <error msg>
        }
      OR
        {
            "success": True,
            "work": {"key": <key>, "status": "created" | "modified" | "matched"},
            "edition": {"key": <key>, "status": "created"},
            "authors": [{"status": "matched", "name": "John Smith", "key": <key>}, ...]
        }
    """

    try:
        # get an OL style edition dict
        rec_as_edition = import_record_to_edition(rec)
        edition: dict[str, Any]
        if existing_edition:
            # Note: This will overwrite any fields in the existing edition. This is ok for
            # now, because we'll really only come here when overwriting a promise
            # item
            edition = existing_edition.dict() | rec_as_edition

            # Preserve source_records to avoid data loss.
            edition['source_records'] = existing_edition.get(
                'source_records', []
            ) + rec.get('source_records', [])

            # Preserve existing authors, if any.
            if authors := existing_edition.get('authors'):
                edition['authors'] = authors

        else:
            edition = rec_as_edition

    except InvalidLanguage as e:
        return {
            'success': False,
            'error': str(e),
        }

    if not (edition_key := edition.get('key')):
        edition_key = web.ctx.site.new_key('/type/edition')

    # Pop the cover URL from the edition record and validate it.
    cover_url = edition.pop('cover_url', None)
    if cover_url and not check_cover_url_host(cover_url):
        return {
            'success': False,
            'error': f'Invalid cover URL host: {urlparse(cover_url).netloc}',
        }

    cover_id = None
    if cover_url:
        cover_id = add_cover(cover_url, edition_key, account_key=account_key)
    if cover_id:
        edition['covers'] = [cover_id]

    edits: list[dict] = []  # Things (Edition, Work, Authors) to be saved
    reply = {}
    # edition.authors may have already been processed by import_record_to_edition(),
    # but not necessarily
    author_in = [
        (
            author_import_record_to_author(a, eastern=east_in_by_statement(rec, a))
            if isinstance(a, dict)
            else a
        )
        for a in edition.get('authors', [])
    ]
    # build_author_reply() adds authors to edits
    (authors, author_reply) = build_author_reply(
        author_in, edits, rec['source_records'][0]
    )

    if authors:
        edition['authors'] = authors
        reply['authors'] = author_reply

    work_key = safeget(lambda: edition['works'][0]['key'])
    work_state = 'created'
    # Look for an existing work
    if not work_key and 'authors' in edition:
        work_key = find_matching_work(edition)
    if work_key:
        work = web.ctx.site.get(work_key)
        work_state = 'matched'
        need_update = False
        for k in subject_fields:
            if k not in rec:
                continue
            for s in rec[k]:
                if normalize(s) not in [
                    normalize(existing) for existing in work.get(k, [])
                ]:
                    work.setdefault(k, []).append(s)
                    need_update = True
        if cover_id:
            work.setdefault('covers', []).append(cover_id)
            need_update = True
        if need_update:
            work_state = 'modified'
            edits.append(work.dict())
    else:
        # Create new work
        work = new_work(edition, rec, cover_id)
        work_state = 'created'
        work_key = work['key']
        edits.append(work)

    assert work_key
    if not edition.get('works'):
        edition['works'] = [{'key': work_key}]
    edition['key'] = edition_key
    edits.append(edition)

    comment = "overwrite existing edition" if existing_edition else "import new book"
    web.ctx.site.save_many(edits, comment=comment, action='add-book')

    # Writes back `openlibrary_edition` and `openlibrary_work` to
    # archive.org item after successful import:
    if 'ocaid' in rec:
        update_ia_metadata_for_ol_edition(edition_key.split('/')[-1])

    reply['success'] = True
    reply['edition'] = (
        {'key': edition_key, 'status': 'modified'}
        if existing_edition
        else {'key': edition_key, 'status': 'created'}
    )
    reply['work'] = {'key': work_key, 'status': work_state}
    return reply
